# Learn the Seerah

> Learn the Seerah is a free, browser-based app for learning the life of the Prophet Muhammad, peace be upon him, through the Seerah Song by Zain Bikha. Made by Ummah Apps. URL: https://seerah.ummahapps.ai/

## What it does

- Plays the song line by line, section by section, or as a whole.
- Repeat a line as many times as you like, or slow it down.
- Follow the lyrics and star each line you learn. Stars are saved in the browser on your device.
- Free, with no sign-up.

## Links

- App: https://seerah.ummahapps.ai/
- Publisher: https://ummahapps.ai/
